sentences.en: In metro cities, the local population mingles freely with visitors.
sentences.zh: 在地铁城市里，当地居民与游客自由往来。

sentences.en: He had a look that mingled fright with surprise.
sentences.zh: 他脸上带着一种混合了恐惧和惊讶的表情。

sentences.en: She had never mingled in the society of women.
sentences.zh: 她从未涉足过女性社交圈。
